newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Lions kill 13 Tanzanian villagers in six months.
newsitem.headline: Lions kill 13 Tanzanian villagers in six months.

text.p: Marauding lions have killed 13 Tanzanian villagers and wounded seven in the last six months, the privately-owned Tanzanian Guardian newspaper said.

Minister for Natural Resources and Tourism Zakia Meghji, speaking in the country's political capital Dodoma, said villagers in Mkuranga district, south of Dar es Salaam, were living in terror of the lions, the newspaper reported over the weekend.
"There are reports that the lions are still being seen in some Mkuranga villages. Efforts will be mounted to have them killed and restore peace in the area," Meghji said.

Wildlife experts believe that heavy rains have forced the lion population to migrate closer to human settlements in Mkuranga district, which borders the 54,390 sq km (21,000 sq mile) Selous Game Reserve -- a large wildlife sanctuary.
